title: Shell-01 Hardshell
descriptionHtml:
The Shell-01 is a three-layer Gore-Tex hardshell built for sustained weather. It blocks wind and rain while venting moisture, so you stay dry from the inside out. At 480g it packs down small enough to live in a bag until the sky turns.

Cut for layering over a midweight insulator without binding at the shoulders or elbows. Fully taped seams and a storm-flap front zip seal the system; the helmet-compatible hood and adjustable cuffs lock weather out on the bike or the trail.

  • Gore-Tex 3L laminate, 28k waterproof / 20k breathable
  • Fully taped seams throughout
  • Helmet-compatible adjustable hood
  • Pit zips for active venting
  • 480g packable shell weight

title: Cargo Tech Pant
descriptionHtml:
The Cargo Tech Pant [KX-PANT-02] is a movement-first trouser in 4-way stretch ripstop. The fabric flexes through full stride and deep squats, then holds its shape, while a DWR finish sheds light rain and trail spray. Built for the way you actually move through a city.

Tapered from knee to ankle with articulated darting that keeps the leg clean under load. Taped seams and a gusseted crotch handle weather and range without binding.

  • 4-way stretch ripstop nylon with DWR coating
  • Fully taped seams, gusseted crotch
  • Bellowed cargo pockets with secure closures
  • Articulated knees, adjustable ankle cuffs
  • Tapered fit, reinforced high-wear zones

title: Utility Vest 6P
descriptionHtml:
The Utility Vest 6P is a load-carrying layer in abrasion-resistant ripstop nylon. Six pockets distribute phone, wallet, keys, and small tools across the torso so nothing swings or prints. It works as a standalone shell in dry weather or a carry layer under a hardshell.

The fit is trim through the body with full shoulder mobility for transit and city use. Reinforced ripstop resists snags and tearing, and the zip closures keep contents secure on a packed train or a fast walk.

  • 6-pocket organization, zip and bellows mix
  • Ripstop nylon, tear-resistant face
  • Two-way front zip
  • Low-profile fit, layers under a shell
  • Internal media pocket with cable port

title: Sling 4L
descriptionHtml:
The Sling 4L is a single-strap crossbody for the essentials you reach for without stopping. The shell is 500D CORDURA, a high-tenacity nylon that resists abrasion against rough walls, bike frames, and transit poles. Wear it chest-front for quick access or pushed to the back when moving.

The body holds 4 litres across a main compartment and a flat zip stash for phone and cards. A single-pull adjuster sets strap length one-handed, and the webbing routes for left or right shoulder wear.

  • 500D CORDURA shell, 4L capacity
  • YKK water-resistant main zip
  • One-handed strap adjuster, ambidextrous wear
  • Internal flat pocket for phone and cards
  • 340g empty

title: Trail Runner XS
descriptionHtml:
The Trail Runner XS is a low-profile trail shoe built for fast transitions between pavement and dirt. Grip comes from a Vibram Megagrip outsole tuned for wet rock and loose terrain. At 280g per shoe, it stays light underfoot without giving up traction.

A TPU-reinforced midfoot cage locks the foot through off-camber sections, and the breathable engineered mesh upper drains and dries fast after stream crossings. Best on technical trails, gravel access roads, and city-to-trail commutes.

  • Vibram Megagrip outsole, 4mm multidirectional lugs
  • 280g per shoe (US 9), 6mm heel-to-toe drop
  • TPU midfoot cage for lateral lock
  • Quick-drain engineered mesh upper
  • Compressed EVA midsole with rock plate

title: 6-Panel Field Cap
descriptionHtml:
The 6-Panel Field Cap is a structured everyday cap cut from heavyweight cotton twill. The dense weave holds its shape through repeat wear and washing, while a mid-depth crown sits low and clean. Built for daily city rotation, not a single season.

Six panels give the crown a rounded, broken-in profile from day one. A pre-curved brim shades direct sun, and the rear webbing strap with metal slide adjusts to a precise fit. Stitched eyelets keep the interior ventilated on warmer days.

  • Heavyweight cotton twill, garment-washed
  • 6-panel construction, mid crown
  • Pre-curved brim, structured front
  • Adjustable webbing strap, metal slider
  • Embroidered eyelet vents, KX-CAP-06

title: Field Monitors
descriptionHtml:
Field Monitors [KX-AUD-07] are over-ear headphones built for long listening on transit and at the desk. Hybrid adaptive ANC cancels engine drone and HVAC hum; a 40-hour battery clears a full travel week on one charge. Custom 40mm drivers run flat and uncolored — reference, not hyped.

Memory-foam earpads seal with low clamp force for multi-hour wear. The matte chassis folds flat into a hardshell case, and a USB-C quick charge returns five hours of playback in ten minutes.

  • Hybrid adaptive ANC with transparency mode
  • 40-hour battery, USB-C fast charge (10 min = 5 hr)
  • 40mm custom drivers, Bluetooth 5.3, multipoint pairing
  • 3.5mm wired passthrough for zero-latency monitoring
  • Foldable steel-reinforced headband, hardshell case

title: Pulse Earbuds
descriptionHtml:
Pulse Earbuds [KX-AUD-08] are sweat- and rain-rated in-ears for training and commuting. An IPX5 rating shrugs off downpours and heavy sweat, while the 32-hour case keeps them charged across a full week of sessions. Active noise cancellation drops the city to a low floor when you need to focus.

The stem-free shell sits low in the ear with three tip sizes for a locked seal. Touch controls handle calls, tracks, and ANC modes; the pocketable case tops up via USB-C.

  • IPX5 water and sweat resistance
  • 32-hour total runtime with charging case
  • Active noise cancellation plus ambient pass-through
  • Bluetooth 5.3, dual-mic call clarity, low-latency mode
  • Three silicone tip sizes, USB-C case charging

title: Kinetik Watch
descriptionHtml:
Kinetik Watch [KX-WTCH-09] is a GPS training and navigation watch with a hardened build for daily wear. Multi-band GNSS holds an accurate track under tree cover and between buildings; 18 hours in full active GPS mode covers long efforts and ultra-distance days. Optical heart rate, SpO2, and barometric altimeter round out the sensor stack.

The case pairs a steel bezel with a sapphire crystal and a sweat-friendly fluoroelastomer strap. Onboard maps, workout profiles, and notifications sync over Bluetooth.

  • Multi-band GPS, 18-hour active battery
  • Optical HR, SpO2, barometric altimeter, compass
  • Sapphire crystal, steel bezel, 5 ATM water rating
  • Onboard maps and breadcrumb navigation
  • USB-C magnetic charging, fluoroelastomer strap

title: Field Speaker 02
descriptionHtml:
Field Speaker 02 [KX-SPK-10] is a rugged portable speaker for trail, transit, and worksite. An IP67 rating means full dust-proofing and 30-minute submersion survival, so rain, sand, and a dropped-in-the-creek moment are non-events. 24 hours of playback covers a long weekend off-grid.

A passive radiator pushes usable low end from a compact aluminum-and-rubber body. Pair two units for stereo, clip it to a pack with the integrated loop, and recharge over USB-C.

  • IP67 dust-proof and waterproof (1m / 30 min)
  • 24-hour playback per charge, USB-C recharge
  • Passive radiator for extended bass response
  • Stereo pairing of two units, Bluetooth 5.3
  • Shock-resistant rubber housing with carry loop

title: Storm Hoodie
descriptionHtml:
The Storm Hoodie [KX-HOOD-11] is a heavyweight pullover built for cold transit and damp city mornings. A dense 400gsm loopback cotton blend holds heat without bulk, while the structured storm hood seals against wind. This is a layer that earns its weight.

Brushed loopback interior runs soft against skin; the high collar and three-panel hood frame the face for genuine coverage. Cut with a relaxed, square shoulder that layers clean over a base or under a shell.

  • 400gsm heavyweight loopback cotton blend
  • Structured storm hood with drawcord adjustment
  • Ribbed cuffs and hem, reinforced kangaroo pocket
  • YKK hardware, bartacked stress points
  • Garment-dyed, pre-shrunk for stable fit

title: Field Parka 3L
descriptionHtml:
The Field Parka 3L is a three-layer insulated parka for cold, wet conditions. The waterproof shell and synthetic fill hold heat when damp, so it keeps working in sleet and freezing rain where down quits. It runs long through the hips for full-coverage warmth on the platform or the trail.

Fully taped seams and a storm flap seal the shell against driven weather. The two-way front zip opens for stride, and the insulated hood with adjustable cinch traps heat without blocking sightlines.

  • 3L waterproof shell, synthetic insulation
  • Fully taped seams throughout
  • Two-way front zip with storm flap
  • Insulated, adjustable hood
  • Hip-length cut for full coverage

title: Merino Base LS
descriptionHtml:
The Merino Base LS [KX-BASE-13] is a next-to-skin long sleeve spun from 200gsm merino wool. Merino regulates temperature across a wide range and resists odor over multiple wears, making it the default layer for travel, trail, and transit. Light, breathable, quietly warm.

Flatlock seams sit flush against skin to eliminate chafe under pack straps or shell layers. The slim, articulated cut moves with the body and disappears under everything else in the system.

  • 200gsm 100% merino wool, 18.5 micron
  • Flatlock seam construction, zero chafe
  • Natural odor resistance and moisture wicking
  • Slim articulated fit, dropped rear hem
  • Machine washable, mulesing-free wool

title: Roll-Top 22L
descriptionHtml:
The Roll-Top 22L is a weatherproof commuter and day pack that seals against rain with a roll-top closure. The main body uses a coated ripstop shell with taped seams, so contents stay dry through transit and sustained drizzle. Roll three times and clip to compress the load.

The panel-loading layout keeps a padded laptop sleeve flat against the back, with the roll-top expanding capacity when you carry more. Built for bike commutes, transit, and overcast city days.

  • Coated ripstop shell with taped seams
  • 22L capacity, roll-top closure with side clips
  • Padded 16-inch laptop sleeve
  • Weatherproof construction, water-resistant zips
  • Stowable sternum strap for load stability

title: Hip Pack 2L
descriptionHtml:
The Hip Pack 2L is a minimal waist pack for keys, phone, and cards when you move light. A weatherproof zip and coated shell keep the contents dry through rain and sweat, so it works on trail runs as well as transit. Wear it at the hip or slung across the chest.

The 2-litre body holds a phone and small essentials flat against the body, with a webbing belt that cinches one-handed and tucks away clean. Low bulk, no bounce.

  • Coated shell, 2L capacity
  • Weatherproof zip closure
  • One-handed webbing belt adjuster
  • Internal key clip and flat card slot
  • 120g empty

title: Merino Beanie
descriptionHtml:
The Merino Beanie is a fine-gauge knit cap in 100% merino wool. Merino regulates temperature and resists odor, so it works across transit, trail, and standing-around cold without the itch of coarse wool. Warm at low bulk.

A 2x1 rib pattern delivers stretch and recovery, holding to the head without pinching. The folded cuff doubles the knit over the ears for added warmth and can be worn shallow or deep. Soft enough to wear directly against skin all day.

  • 100% merino wool, fine gauge
  • 2x1 rib knit, four-way stretch
  • Folded cuff, adjustable depth
  • Temperature-regulating, odor-resistant
  • Machine wash cold, KX-BEAN-16

title: Touch Gloves
descriptionHtml:
Touch Gloves are lightweight liner gloves engineered for cold-weather phone use. Conductive yarn knit into the thumb and index fingertips drives capacitive screens without bare hands, so navigation, transit cards, and messages stay glove-on. Built for commutes and shoulder-season cold.

An articulated, pre-curved cut follows the natural bend of the hand for a close fit and full dexterity. The four-way-stretch knit seals at a ribbed cuff to block drafts, and a silicone palm print adds grip on rails, bars, and bag straps.

  • Touchscreen-conductive thumb & index tips
  • Articulated, pre-curved finger construction
  • Four-way-stretch knit, ribbed cuff
  • Silicone palm grip print
  • Low-bulk liner profile, KX-GLOVE-17

title: Power Cell 10K
descriptionHtml:
Power Cell 10K [KX-POWER-18] is a 10000mAh USB-C battery for keeping a phone, earbuds, or watch alive on the move. USB-C Power Delivery pushes a fast top-up — roughly two full phone charges from a flat pack. Pass-through charging lets you power a device while the cell itself refills.

The aluminum shell stays pocket- and pack-friendly, with a recessed four-LED gauge reading remaining capacity at a glance. One USB-C and one USB-A port run two devices at once.

  • 10000mAh capacity, ~2 full phone charges
  • USB-C Power Delivery in and out
  • Pass-through charging supported
  • USB-C and USB-A ports, dual-device output
  • Aluminum body, four-LED capacity gauge
